1.title: Dino Péo Portfolio
1.description: Personal developer portfolio presenting technical skills and completed works with interactive visual effects and instant bilingual switching.

sections.heading: Interactive Experience & Visuals
sections.content: • Interactive 2D Canvas starfield reacting to cursor movement, auto-optimized to conserve mobile battery.\n• Vertical Scroll Preview: Live hover scroll on project cards allowing visitors to preview full interfaces without navigating away.\n• Instant Bilingual Localization: Seamless switching between Vietnamese and English, auto-persisting user preference.

sections.heading: Contact & Architecture Showcase
sections.content: • Direct Contact Form: Send messages directly to personal inbox via EmailJS with instant status alerts.\n• Architectural Bento Stack: Interactive skill grouping by Client, Server, Database, and DevOps layers.\n• Open Source Activity: Real-time commit history and contributions fetched from GitHub.

2.title: Realtime E-Commerce Web
2.description: Real-time online shopping platform connected with Firebase to synchronize products, shopping carts, and order statuses.

sections.heading: Authentication & Product Discovery
sections.content: • Secure user sign-up and sign-in via Firebase Authentication.\n• Smart product search, price range filtering, category navigation, and popularity sorting.

sections.heading: Live Cart & Online Checkout
sections.content: • Real-time cart management: add, update quantities, auto-calculate totals, and persist state.\n• Online checkout workflow storing order details with instant order tracking updates.

3.title: Restaurant & Ordering Web
3.description: Culinary showcase and online reservation website featuring a categorised menu and rapid table booking system.

sections.heading: Menu Exploration
sections.content: • Categorised menu: Appetizers, Main Courses, Grilled dishes, Desserts, and Beverages.\n• Detailed dish previews with ingredients, pricing, and high-resolution photography.

sections.heading: Online Reservation
sections.content: • Quick booking form: Select dining date, time, party size, and special requests.\n• Integrated location map and direct phone ordering buttons.

4.title: ThoiTiet24h — Weather App
4.description: Live weather forecast platform providing accurate real-time meteorological data for cities and provinces.

sections.heading: Real-Time Weather Queries
sections.content: • Search weather by city name or automatic browser geolocation detection.\n• Complete environmental indicators: Temperature, humidity, wind velocity, UV index, and atmospheric pressure.

sections.heading: Hourly & Multi-Day Forecasts
sections.content: • Detailed 24-hour hourly outlook displaying weather trends throughout the day.\n• 7-day extended forecast with visual temperature charts for proactive scheduling.

5.title: DinoCine — Online Movie Hub
5.description: Film discovery and lookup platform connected to TMDB API, offering rich metadata for thousands of cinema releases.

sections.heading: Movie Catalog & Discovery
sections.content: • Curated sections: Now Playing in theatres, Trending weekly, and Top Rated classics.\n• Keyword search and genre filtering (Action, Sci-Fi, Animation, Horror).

sections.heading: Metadata & Trailer Streaming
sections.content: • In-depth movie overviews, IMDb ratings, runtime, directors, and full cast lists.\n• Stream official YouTube video trailers directly within the web interface.

6.title: DinoStore — Online Shop
6.description: Minimalist fashion retail web app focused on streamlined apparel browsing and frictionless cart ordering.

sections.heading: Apparel Browsing & Sizing
sections.content: • Categorised collection with fast filtering by size (S/M/L/XL) and colorways.\n• Multi-angle product imagery paired with body measurement sizing guides.

sections.heading: Cart & Checkout
sections.content: • LocalStorage cart persistence preserving selected items across page reloads.\n• Streamlined checkout form capturing delivery address and order details.

7.title: DinoBot — Discord Utility Bot
7.description: Administration and entertainment bot for Discord communities, featuring automated moderation and member management.

sections.heading: Server Moderation & Safety
sections.content: • Automated newcomer greeting messages and instant auto-role assignment.\n• Message filtering: Auto-detect and purge profanity, antispam defense rules.

sections.heading: Music & Entertainment
sections.content: • On-demand music playback from YouTube and SoundCloud in voice channels.\n• Fun interactive mini-games and a dedicated web landing page for command syntax.

8.title: ShopFSTYLE — Fashion E-Commerce
8.description: Complete e-commerce platform built with PHP & MySQL, featuring customer shopping flows and an Admin dashboard.

sections.heading: Customer Shopping Experience
sections.content: • Browse apparel by categories, select color/size variations, and add to cart.\n• Order placement and customer purchase history tracking.

sections.heading: Admin Management Dashboard
sections.content: • Product inventory management: Add, edit, remove products, stock levels, and prices.\n• Order processing pipeline: Update status (Pending, Shipping, Delivered) and sales reports.

9.title: Pokédex — Mobile App
9.description: Comprehensive mobile Pokédex app developed with React Native & Expo, running smoothly on iOS and Android.

sections.heading: Extensive PokéAPI Database
sections.content: • Explore 800+ Pokémon species with official high-res artwork.\n• Stat radar charts: HP, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed.

sections.heading: Search & Evolution Tracking
sections.content: • Instant search by name or ID, elemental type filtering (Fire, Water, Grass, Electric).\n• Visual evolution chain diagrams showing level and item evolutionary conditions.

10.title: LinkSnap — URL & Bio Shortener
10.description: Smart URL shortener and custom Bio link platform with automated QR generation and live click analytics.

sections.heading: Rapid Link Shortening & QR
sections.content: • Instant URL compression with custom alias branding.\n• Auto-generated high-resolution QR codes for physical scan-to-open distribution.

sections.heading: Bio Page & Live Analytics
sections.content: • 1-minute Link-in-Bio mobile landing page aggregating social links.\n• Real-time analytics dashboard tracking total clicks and device distributions.
